name: Rico ISTS Incident Monitor
description: Exact-source ISTS context, reviewed Jeff alert, and an optional deterministic any-local-group IMT question ingress.

enabled.description: Explicitly enables the three-minute monitor only after the private grant and reviewed adapter are installed.

anyGroupEnabled.description: Independently enables the bounded any-local-group IMT-to-Polar scanner. It does not enable Colleague Zone or broaden normal Rico ingress.

adapterModule.description: Absolute path to an operator-reviewed mode-0600 adapter module.

anyGroupAdapterModule.description: Absolute path to the reviewed one-purpose any-local-group IMT adapter. Required only when the private grant explicitly enables anyLocalGroup.

colleagueZoneAdapterModule.description: Absolute path to the separately reviewed mode-0600, read-only Colleague Zone adapter that uses a dedicated browser-managed persistent profile. Required only when that private source grant is enabled.

permissionFile.description: Absolute path to the private exact-authority grant.

stateDirectory.description: Absolute mode-0700 directory for the private hash-chained state and outbox.
